scripts.check: tsc -p auth/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run check:client
scripts.check:client: .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_location_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_holdings_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_moves_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_decks_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_collection_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_publications_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_reconciliation_client.py --check && .venv/bin/python scripts/generate_discovery_client.py --check
scripts.build: npm run check && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
